problem: Generated R2007 and newer DWGs reopen with canonical CONTINUOUS/BYLAYER/BYBLOCK linetypes carrying flags 64. The system-codec DXF export did not register their metadata before the writer emitted its mandatory rows; the later callback failed and prevented the entire save, including otherwise valid LEADER entities.
change: For installed libdxfrw and DXF R14 or later, collect the three canonical source rows using the same name lookup used by the callback and pass them to setCanonicalLineTypeMetadata before write. The library retains its existing validation, fixed-row emission and handle rules; the bundled path is unchanged.
